protocol_v3_1.claim: The v3.1 corpus snapshot, LOBO/RuAA folds, freeze candidates, exact A0 predictions, and associated corpus bytes are immutable historical evidence only. The ineligible-corpus registry forbids their use for any new scientific run.

protocol_v3_2.claim: The repository owner accepted the remediated v3.2 preparation for bounded evaluator implementation. It derives one local, unapproved atomic bundle only from the exact historical parent, excluding turgenev/записки_охотника, serafimovich/у_нас_и_у_них, and sevsky/дон_на_костылях. It binds full NFC author_id/work_slug identities, content isolation, independently reconstructed 252/248/134 folds, and the unchanged 16-cell/11-comparison matrix without stylo_stack. Frozen-input reconciliation binds immutable design-freeze protocol bytes and explicitly validates the already-chunked corpus by its recorded manifest identity; it does not represent that identity as the current runtime. This owner disposition is not a freeze, execution grant, or independent security verdict.

independent_security_audit.claim: The owner terminated the preparation security review. No independent security-audit PASS or equivalent assurance is claimed; evaluator review is bounded to frozen scientific semantics.

evaluator_candidate.claim: The versioned v3.2 evaluator/evidence-adapter candidate is implemented and reviewed under docs/tasks/2026-08-10-paired-audit-v3-2-evaluator.md. Context construction consumes the immutable protocol identity and the exact stored manifest identity while the environment lock remains spaCy 3.8.11; it performs no chunking, fit, or prediction. Receipt validation derives its expectations independently. A synthetic topic-validity gate confirms that active stylo MFW can encode label-correlated content nouns while the evaluation-only topic_strict control removes that exact controlled dependency. The corrected-corpus magnitude and the model-semantics decision remain unmeasured, so the candidate is an unregistered input to later authorized tasks and carries no production registration or execution authority.

topic_validity_challenger.claim: A research-only A0/A4 current-versus-topic_strict adapter and aggregate-only schema is implemented under docs/tasks/2026-08-23-topic-validity-challenger-v1.md. Its binding maps semantic source roles to byte digests without exposing repository paths. It carries no registry entry, official receipt/result/run identity, model decision, readiness claim, publication or authorization.

topic_validity_execution.claim: The repository owner authorized the bounded R3b corrected-LOBO topic-validity study. Measured orchestration: sequential projected 98.4 hours, fixed-8 reached 10/992 at 957.7 seconds (26.4-hour projection) with safe memory, fixed-16 reached 10/992 at 1162.4 seconds (32.0-hour projection) and was slower under contention. The runner defaults to the measured eight-process fork and resumes from an ignored local checkpoint, so an interrupted run continues instead of discarding its fits. A first execution attempt reached 260/992 before the owner stopped it; no aggregate exists and the corrected-corpus effect stays unmeasured. Scope is exactly 248 LOBO folds, stylo A0/A4, current versus topic_strict, and one aggregate-only artifact. This is not confirmatory, registration, freeze, model-selection, headline or publication authority.
